theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have hxy : (x - 1) * (y - 1) ≥ 0 :=
    calc
      (x - 1) * (y - 1) = x * y - x - y + 1 by ring
      _ = x * y - 2 + 1 by rw h
      _ = x * y - 1 by simp
  apply Real.sq_le.2
  use 1
  · exact le_refl 1
  · exact mul_nonneg hx hy
